description: Splits a polyphonic pitch and gate pair into thirteen pitch and gate pairs, sending each input channel to the first row whose split point its pitch does not exceed

params.text: Sets the split point for that row, shown as a note; an input channel goes to the first row counting downward whose split point is not lower than the channel's pitch

inputs.text: The polyphonic gates, taken channel by channel alongside the pitch

outputs.text: The pitches of the input channels that fell into that row
The pitches of the input channels higher than every split point, for chaining into another instance of the module
The gates of the input channels that fell into that row
The gates of the input channels higher than every split point, for chaining into another instance of the module

notes: the rows are tried from the top down and a channel goes to the first row whose split point is not below its pitch, so a row set no higher than a row above it never receives anything
